name: Classic Maya — documented knowledge and explanatory practices
methodology_note: This panel is scoped to evidence securely relevant to Classic-period Maya traditions, especially inscriptions, calendrical records, and scholarship on lowland Maya astronomy/timekeeping. Monumental writing is strongly biased toward literate and political/ritual elites. Empty 'unknown' does not mean there were no limits to Maya knowledge; it means this panel does not infer absolute ignorance from missing evidence.
notes: 'Maya' is an umbrella Culture entity covering diverse Mayan-language communities. This panel should not be read as proof that every Classic Maya city or social group possessed identical specialist knowledge.
